about:
Protection By ISHAQ Officials is ISHAQ’s own app and a fully official platform.

Currently, you will only find information about ISHAQ on this app. No other content is available at this time.

📌 Our Features:

- ✅ A fully official platform.
- 🔄 Monthly updates to keep you informed.
- 🔐 The app can be unlocked with a one-time payment of just 1 BDT.
- 🌐 ISHAQ has official Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube channels.

Stay connected with us and keep an eye on our official platform for the latest updates.

Thank You! ❤️

— Protection By ISHAQ Officials
